title: It's being rate-limited
fullTitle: Your App Isn't Broken. It's Being Rate-Limited.

scenes.narration: Type a word into the search box. Eight keystrokes, eight requests. Halfway through, the API answers four twenty-nine. Nothing is broken. The app is being rate-limited.
captions: Eight keystrokes, eight requests. Then 429: Too Many Requests.
Nothing is broken. The app is being rate-limited.

scenes.narration: This fixture's limit is a fixed window: five requests per ten seconds, per server-established identity. The sixth is rejected with Retry-After, the whole seconds until the window resets. Rejected requests are not counted here; other APIs differ.
captions: Fixed window: 5 allowed per 10 s, per identity.
The sixth gets 429 + Retry-After. Rejected requests are not counted here.

scenes.narration: The flawed client retries at once. The window has not moved, so it is rejected again, and again. Eight keystrokes became seventeen requests and twelve rejections.
captions: Immediate retry: the window hasn't moved. Rejected again.

scenes.narration: Same scripted typing, corrected client. First, debounce. A request leaves only after two hundred and fifty milliseconds of silence. Eight keystrokes collapse into one request.
captions: Debounce: send only after 250 ms of no typing.

scenes.narration: Second, stale results. Responses can arrive out of order; a short prefix returns slower. Each request carries a sequence number, and a response is applied only if it is still the latest.
captions: Responses can arrive out of order.
A sequence number: apply a response only if it is still the latest.

scenes.narration: Third, abort. When the query changes, the obsolete request is cancelled with AbortController. The fixture server logged the abort. An abort does not prove a real server stopped working.
captions: An abort does not prove the server stopped processing.

scenes.narration: Fourth, respect Retry-After. Round the seconds up, wait, then retry the still-current query at most once. If the query changes, cancel the retry. Not every real four twenty-nine sends this header.
captions: Retry-After: round up, wait, retry the current query at most once.
Query changed? Cancel the retry. Real 429s may omit the header.

scenes.narration: Compare the logs from the same typing. Flawed: seventeen requests, twelve rejected, results shown for the letter p. Corrected: one request, none rejected, results for postgres.
Coordinate the work. Don't just repeat it faster. Debouncing does not replace server-side limiting, and this retry policy is for reads, not for requests that change state.
captions: Coordinate the work. Don't just repeat it faster.
Debouncing is not server-side limiting. Don't reuse this retry policy for writes.
